title: Ruthless EZ DUZ IT Shortfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Ez Duz It by Ruthless takes a simple yet masterfully balanced approach to fruit flavours, blending the juicy sweetness of ripe Strawberries with the crisp, mouthwatering taste of Watermelon. The combination captures the essence of fresh summer fruits at their peak, offering a clean, smooth, and refreshing vape with every inhale. Part of the celebrated Ruthless Shortfill range, Ez Duz It is crafted with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, designed for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered devices. The e-liquid comes in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to tailor the nicotine strength to your preference. Ruthless is one of the earliest pioneers of American e-liquids, setting the standard for bold, distinctive flavours that have shaped the industry. Their expertly crafted blends continue to push boundaries, making Ruthless a firm favourite among vapers who seek high-quality, unforgettable flavour profiles.
